Designed for gamers and professionals with speeds of up to 5300MB/s read and 4500MB/s write, gets 9.6x performance compared to traditional SATA-based SSD. Leverages PCIe Gen 4x4 NVMe1.4 technology standard and backwards compatible with PCIe 3.0.
